title: Nginx TLS Termination and Reverse Proxying
objective: Safely render, validate, and activate HTTPS proxy configuration.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: Nginx can terminate TLS, redirect plaintext HTTP, and proxy requests to an application port. Forwarded headers preserve the original scheme and client context.
Templates notify a reload only when changed. nginx -t must validate the candidate configuration, and an external HTTPS check should confirm the full path after activation.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Safely render, validate, and activate HTTPS proxy configuration.

examples.title: Working design artifact
examples.code:
https_proxy:
  redirect_http: true
  terminate_tls: nginx
  upstream: application
  config_validation: nginx_t
  external_check: required
